summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 112 yen from 92 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, with interim dividend held at 45 yen and year-end dividend increased to 67 yen from 47 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year profit forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revisions to Second Quarter and Full-Year Business Performance Forecasts for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027, and Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Iwaki Co., Ltd. announced on November 11, 2026, a revision to its annual dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The full-year dividend has been increased to 112 yen per share from the previously forecasted 92 yen per share. The interim dividend remains unchanged at 45 yen per share, while the year-end dividend has been raised to 67 yen per share from the prior forecast of 47 yen per share.

The revision reflects an upward adjustment to the company's full-year earnings forecast. Domestic medical device markets, U.S. water treatment markets, and semiconductor and display markets in China, Taiwan, and South Korea performed better than expected. Additionally, yen depreciation favorably affected foreign exchange translation. Sales are now expected to exceed the previous forecast, and inventory normalization has improved the cost of sales ratio, resulting in higher profits across all income levels.

Under its Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 disclosed in May 2025, the company has set a dividend policy of maintaining a dividend payout ratio of 35 percent or higher with a minimum annual dividend of 70 yen for fiscal years 2026 through 2028. The updated 112-yen annual dividend aligns with this policy while reflecting stronger operational performance.
